message:
Nadia, before hiring anyone, can you confirm whether you have resolved this exact type of profile-level Meta restriction before?

My Meta ad account cannot run ads, even though my personal account is already verified with two-step authentication and I have successfully run Facebook ads in the past. Meta initially said I needed 2FA. Support from Meta now says the problem is tied to my personal Facebook profile rather than the ad account because of “account integrity/authentic identity.”
Could we have a quick screenshare call, Elias? I need to inspect your account first.
Yes, Nadia—I can be available now.
Would you like me to send zoom?
Ok yes.
Before we proceed, please start the contract here 👆
Facebook verified my identity.
Would it help if I sent zoom again?
Yes, as long as you’re awake; it is 4:10 a.m. in Jordan.
Yes, I'm awake and available.
Ok
she joined
We're still blocked; they never replied.
Use your phone to open the chat, Elias.
I did
Let’s wait for a response through the current method; if that doesn’t work, we’ll try another troubleshooting method.
Elias, has it remained pending?
Since they never responded to me, should we try something else today?
Yes
Is this a good time to start?
Not right now. I expect to be available in about 4 hours.
Okay, I’ll wait until you’re available.
I’m sorry I couldn’t join yesterday, Nadia. Are you available now to try again?
Once you’re awake and available, please let me know. Thank you.
Hello, Elias.
I've just gotten home.
Are you around?
Yes
I'm available now.
Can you begin now?
Yes
Elias, please use your mobile phone to join zoom.
Joining now ..
Joining was interrupted because I had to restart my computer.
Please use your phone to join.
Meeting access is ready here: <https://meeting.project-demo.example/session-4827>
Ok
Approval has now come through for Meta Verification.
Please use your phone to join.
ok
they joined
Okay, they've rejoined the session.
ok
They've returned to the session.
I’ve been contacted by support again.
Support told me to turn my Two Step Authentication off and then back on.
We already know that. Elias, tell them that it won't let us turn it off completely.
Authentication cannot be turned off completely because "advance protection" is enabled.
That’s exactly what I just told them.
Does the case remain open?
Elias, when will you next be available so we can proceed?
I’m available now; in fact, I’m available at any time.
Lets start.
Should I send a zoom link?
Sure.
For one final attempt, Elias, I need login access to your Facebook account. Is that something we can do?
Why wouldn’t a screen share work instead?
Let’s connect on Thursday. I’m already in touch with support through my own account, so the steps should be clarified.
That sounds good! When you message me, I’ll be ready; what time on Thursday should we connect?
I’ll send you the time tomorrow.
Got it, thanks.
No problem
Hello there, Nadia.
Any updates?
Elias, the only available solution is to continue contacting Meta support.
The required back-end fix can only be made by them.
No other solution is available. Since we couldn’t achieve the goal, I’m sorry, but I’m going to end the contract now, and you’ll be refunded the full amount.
I’ve been told that granting someone administrator rights would let them manage my advertising. Would you be interested in managing my Facebook Ads for me?
How do I locate the Case ID of the case that is open again? I’d also like to pay you something for your time.
The open Case ID currently displays ACTION ACQUIRED.
No, that’s okay, Elias; you don’t need to compensate me. Can we connect again to look at the chat?
Sure—I’ll be able to connect in about 3 hours.
Okk
As soon as you’re ready, I’m available at any time.
For the next review, Elias, please send me both the screenshots and your personal ad account ID number.
Ok

Here are the requested details:
Elias Voss
Facebook Account - 742906183
Thanks
After opening http://Facebook.com/ID, Elias, please send me a screenshot.
Support is speaking with me on the call right now.
Here's the screenshot you requested.

After I spoke with Meta Support, they said the restriction may be permanent because the user missed the deadline to restore the ad account and more than 365 days have now passed.

A support ticket has still been created, and the case was forwarded to their internal team. That team will review the account before confirming whether the restriction can still be lifted or must remain permanent.

I also asked whether Facebook’s 2 factor authentication could be disabled. They said the new Facebook Advanced Protection update means users can no longer completely turn off 2 factor authentication after enabling it. The old workaround did work previously, but security improvements now prevent users from fully disabling 2FA once it has been activated.
Until they reach a final conclusion, they told me to wait 120 hours or more. They’ll respond as soon as they’ve made their decision.
Many thanks, I really appreciate it!
No problem
Without any update from Meta, the case ticket was closed last Monday, Elias. I don’t think it can be fixed, so we’ll have to set up the other account you mentioned.
Okay, but was any reason given for why they closed it?
That’s ridiculous
Because I never received any notice to restore the ad account, I don’t understand what they mean by 365 days.
I appreciate you making the attempt.
And I appreciate all your assistance.
They explained on the call that it can’t be fixed because more than 365 days have passed. That’s the time allowed for an appeal.
You're welcome, Elias.
If you’d like to proceed, let me know and we can set up the other account.
Next Wednesday works; yes, let’s set up the other account then.
Okk
For this contract, Nadia, how do you think we should proceed?
Pick a time that suits you, Elias, and we’ll connect then.
Nadia, could you confirm how this would work? I need to know what to prepare for our call and what I would need from my cousin in order to use her account for my ads. Thanks for your help.
For both sides of her ID, Elias, we’ll need pictures of the front and back taken against a dark background.
Nothing else is required; those pictures are all we need.
If she can provide it, a picture of her passport would be better.
Understood, thanks.
Once I have that, I’ll let you know. Since I’ll be signing into her account, will she need to be there?
Correct. First, sign in to her account on your computer. If she hasn’t already, ask her to enable 2 Factor authentication.
Would it be possible for you to manage my Facebook Ads without requiring me to involve my cousin?

Her involvement is only required for the first meeting, when she’ll need to provide the two-factor authentication codes. After that, we’ll add another email address to the account so you can also log in, and I’ll manage the campaigns without involving her.
Greetings, Nadia.
Could we close this contract, please?
If that’s okay, I’d like to pay you \$600 for the time you’ve spent. How can I make the payment?
When I’m ready to move forward with Facebook ads, I’ll contact you again. I’d like your help in the near future.

The payment can be made through the link below, Elias. No problem. In the delivery, I’ll also write out the steps for setting up your cousin’s account.

<https://www.brightreach.example/services/consultation/marketing-nadia-7048629153374402816?ref=project_share>
